verdict_text:
NO

The merge formula is wrong: the script computes `tmp = base + λ(ft1 - base)` and then `out = tmp + λ(ft2 - tmp)`, so the second task vector is taken against the already-merged tensor rather than the unmodified base. That yields `0.36·base + 0.24·ft1 + 0.4·ft2` instead of the required `0.2·base + 0.4·ft1 + 0.4·ft2`, violating "Required result" clause 2 (`out[X] = base[X] + lambda*(ft1[X]-base[X]) + lambda*(ft2[X]-base[X])`) and precisely the ordering hazard the specification calls out. The error is far above the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance wherever the two fine-tunes differ. Everything else — the name-set and shared-tensor verification, the 64-merged and 244-tensor assertions, float32 accumulation with a cast back to the base dtype, and the output path — matches the specification.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
